score.note: First structural draft, built from a full instruction-level read-through of games/gs1/asm/080ceb54.s (cross-checked against out/family-transplants/main-080ceb54/m2c/target.canonical.s and m2c/080ceb54.c for literal-pool values only, not statement shape) rather than the naive symbol-retargeted transplant seed, which the task brief already confirmed differs by hundreds of halfwords for this owner. Two real structural fixes were found and applied during iteration: (1) `facing` must be read as `*(s32*)((u8*)heap_cache-108)`, not a fresh `*(s32*)0x03001E80` literal -- the reference reuses the same r2 that holds heap_cache (subs r2,#108) rather than a second literal-pool load, matching the shared-heap_cache-base idiom already documented on 080d82b0/080e01e4; (2) both `variant==0 ? 134 : 133`-shaped resource-id selections (at the outer==80 and outer==fp+71 trigger sites) must be written as explicit if/else, not a ternary -- the reference emits two literal `movs r0,#134`/`movs r0,#133` blocks behind a real branch, while a ternary let this compiler fold the two arms into a `134 - (bool)variant` arithmetic trick, which does not match. Fixing both dropped wrong_instructions from 449 to 404 and differing_halfwords from 499 to 489. The dominant remaining divergence (490-odd wrong instructions, nearly the whole candidate) is a single register-allocation phenomenon, not further source-shape bugs: this compiler spills `work` to the stack for its entire life instead of keeping it in a callee-saved high register (sl) the way the reference does from its very first use (mov sl,r1) onward. Every one of the dozens of M2C_FIELD(work,...) accesses throughout the function therefore compiles to an extra stack reload in the candidate, which cascades into which OTHER value (the spawn loop's hoisted 0xFF mask) claims sl instead, and from there into a long tail of matching-value-different-register/different-scheduling diffs identical in kind to the already-documented family residual (see 080d82b0.json's score.note: 'why the reference keeps the shared work pointer in r9 while this compiler's candidate keeps choosing a different register for it in places'). Tried and reverted: caching `Data_080ee090[loop_start+1] + member_count*20` in a named local instead of recomputing the expression fresh at both the loop-entry check and the loop-continue check (matching the reference's own repeated 5-instruction recomputation) -- this was a real fix (removed a spuriously wide-lived local) and is kept, but did not touch the work/sl spill. A reduced-body experiment (truncating the function immediately after the Func_080cef64 call) showed the compiler using r5/r6 for work/variant in that short a function instead of the high registers at all, confirming the spill is a whole-function register-pressure decision rather than something localized to one section, and is not something a partial rewrite of any one section can be expected to flip. Per CONTRIBUTING.md and the Cleanroom skill's stalled-last-mile guidance, this is recorded as the open residual rather than chased with hand register hints (prohibited) or open-ended permutation (not warranted at this distance from exact).

rejected_experiments: Caching `M2C_FIELD(M2C_FIELD(work,void**,0x7828),s32*,20) * 20` in a named local reused at both the outer-loop entry check and the loop-continue check: this made the local artificially wide-lived across the whole outer loop where the reference recomputes the five-instruction expression fresh at each site. Reverted to two separate inline recomputations; this alone dropped wrong_instructions from 429 to 404 (folded into the current draft, not a pure revert).

Truncating the function body immediately after the Func_080cef64 call (early return) to see whether work claims sl in a much smaller function: it did not use sl at all in that short a body (r5/r6 sufficed), confirming the sl-vs-spill decision for work is a whole-function register-pressure computation, not a localized effect of any single early statement. Reverted, no source change kept from this probe.

Semantic summary: a battle-presentation sub-effect taking (object, variant). Publishes object into the shared work block, copies a fixed resource (id 0x69) through Func_08005340, then copies a variant-selected palette/tile block (0xBB/0x8D/0x91) into VRAM through the generic word-copy trampoline (0x03001388) via Func_080072f0, then resolves a cached draw-callback pair via Func_080cef64 using state field 4 as the flag. Blanks a 1024-slot shared particle pool (28 bytes/slot, validity field -1) at 0x02010000, then for each active party member seeds that member's 128-slot sub-range with member position/handle plus three randomized velocity offsets. Registers two per-frame callbacks (0x080DBB9D, 0x080CD261) and runs `Data_080ee090[variant*2+1] + member_count*20` frames. Each frame rewrites the 160-entry per-scanline table at work+0x6980 from a single sine curve, then for every party member whose staggered window is open (gated by `Data_080ee090[variant*2]`, the per-frame burst count) draws and advances that member's active particle slots through the resolved callback, and once a per-slot delay threshold passes, nudges each particle's velocity toward the member's current position and freezes it (validity=-1) once the per-axis velocity delta clamps within +-0x1FFE of zero.

The two Func_080b50e8/Func_080f9010(134-or-133-by-variant) trigger sites are genuinely duplicated `if(variant==0){...134...}else{...133...}` blocks in the reference, not a computed selection -- see score.note. Anywhere else this owner selects between two small constants by variant, prefer the same explicit-branch shape over a ternary unless a --align check confirms otherwise.

The dominant open residual is register allocation, not source shape: this compiler spills the whole-function-lived `work` pointer to the stack instead of keeping it in sl throughout, unlike the reference and unlike this owner's own closest siblings' reported behavior. This reads as the same class of already-documented, non-source-shape-controllable residual flagged on 080d82b0.json/080dc1ec.json/080e01e4.json (register choice for a loop-invariant address, and independent-immediate-load scheduling order), just manifesting here as a full spill rather than merely a different high register -- plausibly because this owner's frame carries more simultaneously-live locals (a second function parameter, an extra loop-index table, a resolved callback pair) than any prior sibling. Per CONTRIBUTING.md, not chased with register hints or forced assignment; a future pass revisiting this whole family's register pressure together (rather than owner by owner) may be the more productive angle.
No GS2 or external source was used; no other Golden Sun decompilation project was consulted.
